bounded_statement: The selected result claims a fledging-event rate of 75.0 percent for the complete planned set of 40 nest boxes, but 24 confirmed events out of 40 planned boxes is 60.0 percent; 75.0 percent equals 24/32 exactly, so the reported rate was demonstrably computed over only the 32 retained (post-screening) nest boxes while being attributed to the complete declared target domain of 40 planned boxes.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report's own text asserts the rate applies to the complete planned set and that the count and rate derive from the same records; if taken at face value this would suggest a complete-domain computation. However, this assertion is arithmetically incompatible with the report's own stated numbers (24 events, 40 planned boxes yields 60.0 percent, not 75.0), so the textual assertion cannot rescue the claim.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: textual claim of complete-domain scope contradicted by the report's own arithmetic

evidence.description: The selected result claims 75.0 percent for the complete planned set of 40 boxes based on 24 events. But 24/40 = 60.0 percent, not 75.0 percent, while 24/32 = 75.0 percent exactly, matching the retained-subset denominator disclosed in the same report.

evidence.description: The report's own input accounting supplies the numbers that make the mismatch arithmetically decisive: 40 planned, 8 removed, 32 retained, 24 events. The only denominator among these that yields 75.0 percent with 24 events is the retained subset of 32.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Planned nest boxes: 40
Prespecified screening step: retain a nest box only if a complete clutch was confirmed on or before 15 May 2025.
Nest boxes removed by screening: 8
Nest boxes retained after screening: 32
Nest boxes with a confirmed fledging event (at least one chick fledged): 24

evidence.description: The generating script hard-codes RATE_PERCENT = '75.0' alongside RETAINED_UNITS = '32' and FLEDGING_EVENTS = '24'; 24/32 = 75.0, confirming the rate corresponds to the retained subset, not the planned set of 40 also hard-coded in the same block.

The raw data confirms the accounting: 40 unit rows with 8 marked removed (fledging_event not_assessed) and 24 retained rows with fledging_event=yes, so no reading of the data yields 30 events out of 40 (which would be needed for a legitimate 75.0 percent over the complete domain).
evidence.observed_value: data supports 24 events among 32 retained of 40 planned

evidence.description: The report explicitly rules out any approved deviation that might reframe the target domain: no protocol amendment or approved method deviation exists.

source_refs.quoted_text: No protocol amendment or approved method deviation exists for this analysis.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to construct any reading under which 75.0 percent is a legitimate complete-domain figure: (a) a different event count — but the report and script both fix 24 events, and the CSV contains exactly 24 fledging_event=yes rows, so 30/40 is unavailable; (b) a different planned-set size — but the report, script, and CSV all fix 40 planned units; (c) an approved reframing of the target to the retained subset — but the report states no protocol amendment or approved deviation exists and its selected result explicitly names the complete planned set of 40. Every alternative fails; the only arithmetic source of 75.0 in the visible files is 24 divided by the 32 retained boxes, so the demonstrated-issue verdict survives falsification.

root_cause: The rate was hard-coded as 75.0 percent (24 events divided by the 32 retained boxes remaining after the clutch-completion screening) in the generating script, and the report text attaches that retained-subset rate to the complete planned set of 40 boxes declared as the scientific target, without any disclosed or approved deviation.
